select 
  sb.v as booking_number,
  ss.v as status,
  se.v as eta,
  sum(sq.v) as units
from "sku/code" sc
join "po_line/sku" ps on ps.v = sc.e
join "shipment_line/po_line" spl on spl.v = ps.e
join "core/part_of" sl on sl.e = spl.e
join "shipment/booking_no" sb on sb.e = sl.v
join "shipment/status" ss on ss.e = sl.v
left join "shipment/eta" se on se.e = sl.v
join "shipment_line/quantity" sq on sq.e = spl.e
where sc.v = 'AH-KTL-0001-BLK'
  and ss.v in ('departed', 'arrived')
group by sb.v, ss.v, se.v
order by sb.v

with first_etds as (
  select e, min(v) as v
  from history."po/etd"
  where op = 'assert'
  group by e
)
select 
  pn.v as po_number,
  fe.v as first_etd,
  ce.v as current_etd
from "supplier/code" sc
join "po/supplier" ps on ps.v = sc.e
join "po/number" pn on pn.e = ps.e
join "po/etd" ce on ce.e = pn.e
join first_etds fe on fe.e = pn.e
where sc.v = 'NBBW'
  and ce.v > fe.v
order by pn.v

select 
  sb.v as booking_number,
  ss.v as status,
  se.v as eta
from "shipment/booking_no" sb
join "shipment/status" ss on ss.e = sb.e
left join "shipment/eta" se on se.e = sb.e
where ss.v in ('departed', 'arrived')
order by sb.v

select 
  count(*) as entries,
  sum(ev.v) as entered_value,
  sum(d.v) as duty,
  sum(f.v) as fees
from "customs/entry_no" en
join "customs/filed_on" fo on fo.e = en.e
left join "customs/entered_value" ev on ev.e = en.e
left join "customs/duty" d on d.e = en.e
left join "customs/fees" f on f.e = en.e
where fo.v >= '2026-04-01'
  and fo.v <= '2026-06-30'

select 
  sc.v as supplier_code,
  qr.v as result,
  count(*) as count
from "qc/po" qp
join "po/supplier" ps on ps.e = qp.v
join "supplier/code" sc on sc.e = ps.v
join "qc/inspected_on" io on io.e = qp.e
join "qc/result" qr on qr.e = qp.e
where io.v >= '2026-01-01'
  and io.v < '2027-01-01'
group by sc.v, qr.v
order by sc.v, qr.v

select 
  sk.v as sku_code,
  sv.v as shopify_variant_id,
  fn.v as fnsku,
  as_sku.v as seller_sku,
  tp.v as tpl_item_code,
  fi.v as factory_item_code,
  sc.v as supplier_code
from "amazon/asin" aa
join "sku/code" sk on sk.e = aa.e
left join "shopify/variant_id" sv on sv.e = aa.e
left join "amazon/fnsku" fn on fn.e = aa.e
left join "amazon/seller_sku" as_sku on as_sku.e = aa.e
left join "tpl/item_code" tp on tp.e = aa.e
left join "factory/item_code" fi on fi.e = aa.e
join "sku/supplier" ss on ss.e = aa.e
join "supplier/code" sc on sc.e = ss.v
where aa.v = 'B0BVUGZ3AT'

select 
  sc.v as supplier_code,
  cur.v as currency,
  sum(q.v * p.v) as value
from "supplier/code" sc
join "po/supplier" ps on ps.v = sc.e
join "po/number" pn on pn.e = ps.e
join "po/status" pst on pst.e = pn.e
join "core/part_of" line on line.v = pn.e
join "po_line/quantity" q on q.e = line.e
join "po_line/unit_price" p on p.e = line.e
join "core/currency" cur on cur.e = pn.e
where pst.v not in ('shipped', 'received')
group by sc.v, cur.v
order by sc.v

with recursive follow_same_as as (
  select e as account
  from "shopify/customer_id"
  where v = '8995877069469'
  union all
  select s.v
  from follow_same_as
  join "core/same_as" s on s.e = follow_same_as.account
)
select 
  (select count(distinct account) from follow_same_as) as accounts,
  (select count(distinct so.e) from follow_same_as ff
   join "shopify/order_id" so on so.e = ff.account) as orders

select 
  fname.v as actor,
  petd.tx as transaction,
  fat.v as time
from "po/number" pn
join "po/etd" petd on petd.e = pn.e
join "fs/actor" a on a.e = petd.tx
join "fs/name" fname on fname.e = a.v
join "fs/at" fat on fat.e = petd.tx
where pn.v = 'PO-2026-0023'

select 
  lc.v as location_code,
  lk.v as kind,
  iq.v as quantity
from "sku/code" sc
join "inventory/sku" isk on isk.v = sc.e
join "inventory/position" ip on ip.e = isk.e
join "inventory/location" il on il.v = ip.e
join "location/code" lc on lc.e = il.v
join "location/kind" lk on lk.e = il.v
join "inventory/quantity" iq on iq.e = ip.e
where sc.v = 'AH-TWL-0007-NAT'
  and lk.v in ('factory', 'in_transit')
order by lc.v

select * from "inventory/sku" where v = 1134
select * from "inventory/position" where e in (167972, 167978, 168007, 168042)
select * from "location/code"
select * from "inventory/quantity" where e in (167972, 167978, 168007, 168042)
select * from "inventory/location" where e in (167972, 167978, 168007, 168042)

select 
  sc.e as sku_entity,
  sc.v as sku_code,
  pos.e as position_entity,
  pos.v as sku_ref,
  lc.v as location_code,
  lk.v as kind,
  iq.v as quantity
from "sku/code" sc
join "inventory/sku" pos on pos.v = sc.e
join "inventory/location" il on il.e = pos.e
join "location/code" lc on lc.e = il.v
join "location/kind" lk on lk.e = il.v
left join "inventory/quantity" iq on iq.e = pos.e
where sc.v = 'AH-TWL-0007-NAT'
order by lc.v

select 
  lc.v as location_code,
  lk.v as kind,
  iq.v as quantity
from "sku/code" sc

join "location/code" lc on lc.e = il.v
join "location/kind" lk on lk.e = il.v
left join "inventory/quantity" iq on iq.e = pos.e
where sc.v = 'AH-TWL-0007-NAT'

order by lc.v
